messages:
Alex: Quick sync — planning to shift traffic for flag ff/response-prioritizer. Proposal: ramp 2% -> 10% over 3h (steps 2, 5, 10). Audience = new_user only, exclude internal & test orgs. Guardrails: p95 latency, error_rate, rerank_ctr. Stop rules below. @Sam can you watch dashboards?
Morgan: Sounds good. Metric names to use: infra.latency_p95, svc.error_rate, eval.rerank_ctr. Also add eval.rerank_quality (manual eval).
Jia: I'll prepare the experiment config and flag gates. Draft snippet: ```json
{"flag":"ff/response-prioritizer","audience":{"new_user":true,"exclude_tags":["internal","automated_tests"]},"steps":[{"pct":2,"dur":"30m"},{"pct":5,"dur":"90m"},{"pct":10,"dur":"60m"}],"rollback_conditions":[{"metric":"infra.latency_p95","cond":">","threshold_ms":50,"window":"10m"},{"metric":"svc.error_rate","cond":">","threshold_pct":0.5,"window":"10m"},{"metric":"eval.rerank_ctr","cond":"<","threshold_pct":-3,"window":"30m"}]}
```
Sam: I can run shadow run + small smoke before ramp. I will create a dashboard watch and a pager rule for the three rollback conditions. Slack alert to #eng-platform? @Morgan?
Morgan: yes please, send alerts to #eng-platform and to oncall. Also tag the experiment id so docs can track it. Use prefix exp:rp-2025-06-04.
Alex: One more: fallback behavior should route to model_v2 baseline when ff is off or on rollback. Add a circuit-breaker to limit failed requests to 1% per minute.
Jia: noted, I'll add fallback_variant: model_v2 and circuit_breaker: {"rate_pct":1,"window":"1m"} in config. Pushing PR to experiments repo in a bit.
Sam: I'll be online for the 2% rollout and will escalate if any signal trips. If everything stable after 2h at 10% we can leave for 24h then decide A/B evaluation.
Alex: Decision criteria for success: no rollback triggers, <1% relative error increase, rerank_ctr uplift >= +1.5% with p < 0.05. If marginal, schedule manual eval.
Morgan: Reminder: include a short prompt/eval set in the PR so Optimize can run quality regression checks automatically.
DeployBot: experiment exp:rp-2025-06-04 scheduled by Jia at 1746130800 — preflight checks ok. :rocket: 
Jia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/experiments/pull/421 — includes config, dashboard links, and test set. Assigning to @Morgan for final review.
Morgan: Reviewing now, will merge after nits. @Alex, @Sam: any last asks?
Alex: no, thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll post a short postmortem template in the thread if we need rollback.
Morgan: Merged. Kicking off 2% smoke in 10m.
Alex: Great. Keep updates here. :eyes:
